articles.headline: Injured Pulisic 'disappointed in myself' as World Cup ends
articles.description: Christian Pulisic was forced off with an ankle injury in the second half of the United States' World Cup round of 16 loss  against Belgium.

articles.headline: USMNT dismisses Balogun noise in World Cup exit: 'Not an excuse'
articles.description: The U.S. men's national team crashed out of the World Cup on Tuesday in a 4-1 loss to Belgium, but players denied that the whirlwind surrounding Folarin Balogun's reversed suspension was a distraction.

articles.headline: Why Spain's substitutes were so important vs. Portugal
articles.description: Alex Kirkland reacts to Spain's late 1-0 win over Portugal to advance to the quarterfinals.

articles.headline: Belgium seemingly reference Balogun, troll U.S. after round-of-16 win
articles.description: Belgium defeated the USMNT 4-1 in the 2026 World Cup round-of-16 match Monday night -- and poked fun at the U.S. afterward.

articles.headline: Mauricio Pochettino mum on USMNT future, tells fans to keep faith
articles.description: Mauricio Pochettino would not offer an indication about whether he wants to remain as coach of the United States men's national team following the Americans' exit from the World Cup here on Monday.

articles.headline: USMNT's World Cup dream crushed by Belgium in round of 16
articles.description: Even with Folarin Balogun back up front, the United States men's national team crashed out of the World Cup in the round of 16 again.
